name: print-social-navy-brand-card-collage-with-lifestyle-photos
title: Navy frame card and four rounded tiles pairing short slogans with smiling lifestyle photos
whatItIs: A white board with a large navy panel holding a white portrait card of a woman with phone and card and a CTA, plus four square tiles: two solid navy with slogans ('Spend money with control.', 'Move money when you need it.') and two photos (car passenger, man laughing) with text and a logo pill.
whatItMeans: Warm and cohesive; alternating solid and photo tiles sets the brand voice.
techniques: Alternate solid colour and photo tiles.
Put the logo in a white pill on every tile.
Frame in a bento of rounded squares.

vocabulary.definition: Switching between colour and photo squares.
A white capsule with the logo.
A tile whose main job is a slogan.
A layout of unequal rounded tiles.
